text:
The NOVA logo reveal is built: a 4-second, 1920×1080 comp on a navy background (`#0B1D3A`) with off-white type and one mint accent (`#3DDC97`) used only on the slash.

- **Mark (group "Mark"):** the off-white ring draws on from 0.2 to 1.1 s, then the mint diagonal slash draws across it from 0.9 to 1.4 s.
- **Wordmark ("Wordmark NOVA"):** starts behind the mark's right edge, clipped by "Wordmark reveal", and slides out 80 px from 1.3 to 2.2 s.
- **Tagline ("Tagline"):** "Money, made simple" fades in and rises 14 px from 2.1 to 2.8 s, in a muted blue-grey so the accent stays unique.
- **Hold:** the full lockup sits still from 2.8 s to the end, so the last 1.2 s are clean.

My first build placed the mark's children with absolute coordinates inside its group, so the mark landed at the bottom of the frame. I fixed that and checked the frames again. The only remaining check flag is the ring and slash overlap, which is intentional.

I left out secondary motion (overshoot or settle) to keep the reveal clean, as you asked. If you want it, I can add a small overshoot on the wordmark or a slow breathing scale on the mark during the hold.
